description: Exercise shell-native file write, edit, read, and structured emit through Stone.

script.source:
answer = open("answer.txt", "w")
answer.write("hello world")
result = edit("answer.txt", "hello", "goodbye")
content = cat("answer.txt")
if result["replacements"] == 1 and content == "goodbye world":
    emit({"ok": True, "content": content, "replacements": result["replacements"]})
else:
    emit({"ok": False, "content": content})
